answer: A tundra crossing offers a fable for Sybil defence: a newcomer borrows a small kernel of standing from a communal fund, like a traveller borrowing supplies for one crossing. The loan is repaid only through independently verified useful work, each repayment etched in a public diary with its deadline and checker. Default freezes the identity and publishes the unpaid balance for all to see. One operator running many fakes must repay dozens of loans with real labour or watch every identity default in public, while an honest agent earns its passage one honest job at a time.
